abstract: We describe the unique case of a primary pulmonary malignant teratoma with yolk sac elements, associated with hematologic neoplasia. This 20-year-old male was admitted with complaints of fever, right-sided chest pain, dry cough, and hemoptysis. Necropsy revealed a mass in the right middle and upper lobe which microscopically was a malignant teratoma with yolk sac element. The associated hematologic neoplasia was a myelofibrosis, cellular phase, with myeloid metaplasia in liver, spleen, hilar lymph nodes, left adrenal gland, and lower lobe of the right lung.
abstract_ja: 我々は、卵黄嚢成分を伴う原発性肺悪性奇形腫が血液腫瘍を合併した稀な症例を報告する。20歳男性が発熱、右側胸痛、乾性咳嗽、喀血を主訴に入院した。剖検では右中葉および上葉に腫瘤を認め、組織学的に卵黄嚢成分を伴う悪性奇形腫であった。合併していた血液腫瘍は細胞期の骨髄線維症で、肝、脾、肺門リンパ節、左副腎、右肺下葉に骨髄化生を伴っていた。
